label: Ultra-fast wound healing
description:
Carriers of this gene heal wounds unnaturally quickly, often recovering from even the most serious injuries in mere hours. It won't fix permanent scars or blood loss.

Complexity: +4
Archite capsules: +2

label: Gene implanter
description:
Carriers of this gene can implant a copy of their xenogerm into another person through a somewhat gross-looking injector organ. Their own genetic material will then regrow very slowly. If they implant while their genes are regrowing, they will die. Germline genes will be unaffected.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Gives ability:
- Implant genes

label: Archite metabolism
description:
Carriers of this gene have special archites in their cells that facilitate and optimize metabolism. This improves overall genetic and metabolic quality.

Complexity: +6
Metabolic efficiency: +6
Archite capsules: +2

label: Deathless
description:
Carriers of this gene have archites in the blood which will sustain their life processes no matter what. As long as the brain remains intact, a carrier of this gene will never die.

Complexity: +7
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Can only die from destruction of brain.

label: Ageless
description:
Carriers of this gene have archites in the bloodstream which continuously reverse the process of aging. Starting at the age of 13, carriers begin to biologically age slower. By 18, the aging process stops completely.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Aging factors:
- 13 years: x100%
- 18 years: x0%

label: Scarless
description:
Carriers of this gene have a special type of regenerator cell which can heal old wounds and chronic illnesses like bad back.

Complexity: +4
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Every 15-30 days, one old wound or chronic illness is healed.

label: Non-senescent
description:
Carriers of this gene do not go through senescence in the normal way. They never get chronic age-related diseases like cancer, bad back, cataracts, or dementia.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Immune to:
- Carcinoma
- Heart attack
- Bad back
- Frail
- Cataract
- Dementia
- Alzheimer's
- Asthma
- Artery blockage

label: Perfect immunity
description:
Carriers of this gene have archite-enhanced immune systems which intelligently destroy invaders. They are totally immune to most normal illnesses.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Immune to:
- Flu
- Malaria
- Sleeping sickness
- Plague
- Infection
- Lung rot
- Gut worms
- Muscle parasites
- Organ decay

label: Breathless
description:
Carriers of this gene can store concentrated oxygen in their bodies. Their cells consume much less oxygen, meaning they rarely need to breathe. These adaptations make them immune to the harmful effects of space, as well as environmental toxins, tox gas, acidic smog, and rot stink.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Toxic environment resistance +100%
- Vacuum resistance +100%
- Min comfortable temperature -5.0C
- Tox gas immunity

Mood:
- Removes: Toxic fallout: -5
- Removes: Acidic smog: -5

label: Strong stomach
description:
Carriers of this gene have an extra toxin-filtering organ in their stomach and will never suffer from food poisoning even after eating rotten food.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Effects:
- Immune to food poisoning.

label: Robust digestion
description:
Carriers of this gene grow a multi-fold stomach, allowing them to digest raw foods more efficiently than baseline humans. In general, they get the same nutrition from raw food as from if it is cooked. They also don't mind the taste of raw food at all.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Raw nutrition multiplier x180%

Mood:
- Removes: Ate raw food: -7

label: Carnivore stomach
description:
Carriers of this gene have specialized stomachs that can extract more nutrition from raw meat, but are poor at digesting plant-based foods. They never get negative thoughts from eating meat.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +1

Effects:
- Raw meat nutrition multiplier x180%
- Raw vegetable nutrition multiplier x50%
- Cooked vegetable nutrition multiplier x80%
- Raw meat food poisoning chance x0%

Mood:
- Removes: Ate corpse: -12
- Removes: Raw cannibalism: -20
- Removes: Cooked cannibalism: -15
- Removes: Ate insect meat: -6
- Removes: Ate cooked insect meat: -3
- Removes: Ate human meat: -20
- Removes: Ate human meat: -12
- Removes: Ate human meat: -5
- Removes: Ate meat: -24
- Removes: Ate meat: -12
- Removes: Ate meat: -4

label: Herbivore stomach
description:
Carriers of this gene have specialized stomachs that can extract more nutrition from raw plant-based foods, but are poor at digesting meat. They never get negative thoughts from eating plant-based foods.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +1

Effects:
- Raw vegetable nutrition multiplier x180%
- Raw meat nutrition multiplier x50%
- Cooked meat nutrition multiplier x80%
- Raw vegetable food poisoning chance x0%

Mood:
- Removes: Ate vegetarian: -16
- Removes: Ate vegetarian: -10
- Removes: Ate vegetarian: -4

label: Fungus eater
description:
Carriers of this gene have special digestive enzymes that extract more nutrition from raw fungus - but they don't do anything about the taste.

Complexity: +1

Effects:
- Raw fungus nutrition multiplier x180%
- New buildables: Fungal gravel
- New recipes: Make wort from fungus

label: Meat dependence
description:
Carriers of this gene are unable to synthesize certain essential nutrients and must obtain them by eating raw meat. Without it, their health and mood will steadily decline, leading to pain, muscle weakness, mental instability, coma, and eventually death.

Takes effect after age: 13

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +3

Mood:
- Removes: Ate meat: -24
- Removes: Ate meat: -12
- Removes: Ate meat: -4

label: Acid spray
description:
Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a sticky acid substance, along with acid-tolerant tissues in the mouth. They can spew this acid over an area, where it will stick to enemies and burn them.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Acid spray

label: Animal warcall
description:
Carriers of this gene can perform an animal warcall, using a powerful bellow and psychic connection to call an animal to fight for them.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -3

Gives ability:
- Animal warcall

label: Fire spew
description:
Carriers are able to spew flammable bile generated by a special organ in their neck. The bile sticks to anything in a small area and can ignite people, objects, and the ground.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Fire spew

label: Foam spray
description:
Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a fire-retardant foam. They can spew this foam over an area to extinguish fires.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Foam spray

label: Feral rage
description:
Carriers have the ability to enter a state of feral rage, giving increased movement speed and faster melee attacks. After the rage ends, there is a temporary backlash which causes pain and slows movement.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Feral rage

label: Sonic wave
description:
Carriers of this gene are able to release a wave of high-intensity ultrasonic noise and psychic energy at a target. The noise will stun any non-mechanoid creature nearby.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -3

Gives ability:
- Sonic wave

label: EMP burst
description:
Carriers have a specialized muscle-derived organ that can release an electric shock in an area around them, disabling nearby electronic devices.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- EMP burst

label: Oil spray
description:
Carriers have glands in their neck that can be used to spray a sticky oil that blinds opponents and leaves flammable puddles.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Oil spray

label: Toxic burst
description:
Carriers have the ability to release a cloud of tox gas around them from a special gland located near their anus. The gas affects the user normally.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Toxic burst

label: Rock toss
description:
The carrier can pick up a rock chunk in combat and toss it. It will land near a targeted location, damaging everything in a radius around where it lands.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Rock toss

label: Burden
description:
The carrier automatically learns the burden psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Slow the target for a short time by suppressing motor activity in the brain.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Burden

label: Chunk skip
description:
The carrier automatically learns the chunk skip psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Skip the closest 5 chunks of rock or slag to scatter them near the target point. This is useful for producing cover during offensive operations.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Chunk skip

label: Painblock
description:
The carrier automatically learns the painblock psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Block pain pathways in the target's brain for a short time. This can allow a person to move and act even with grievous injuries which would normally incapacitate them.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Painblock

label: Solar pinhole
description:
The carrier automatically learns the solar pinhole psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Generate a microscopic skipgate linked to the core of a nearby star. Solar material leaks through the pinprick in spacetime, illuminating and warming the surrounding area until it closes. The light is enough to work by, but not enough to grow plants.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Solar pinhole

label: Stun
description:
The carrier automatically learns the stun psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Momentarily disrupt motor function in the target's brain, preventing any movement.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Stun

label: Word of trust
description:
The carrier automatically learns the word of trust psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Speak to the prisoner while using psychic suggestion to reduce their resistance to recruitment. This can only reduce a prisoner's resistance, but cannot recruit them.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Word of trust

label: Blinding pulse
description:
The carrier automatically learns the blinding pulse psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Induce noise in the visual centers of the brain, obscuring vision of everyone near the target point.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Blinding pulse

label: Neural heat dump
description:
The carrier automatically learns the neural heat dump psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Instantly dump all your neural heat into someone else. As a side-effect, the target will fall into a debilitating but non-damaging coma for about a day. The target must actively accept the psychic invasion, so only conscious allies can be targeted.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Neural heat dump

label: Waterskip
description:
The carrier automatically learns the waterskip psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Douse a target area in water, extinguishing fires. The water is archotechnologically skipped from distant bodies of water or underground aquifers.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Waterskip

label: Word of joy
description:
The carrier automatically learns the word of joy psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Speak happy, calming words to someone while using psychic suggestion to implant a joyfuzz loop in their mind. The joyfuzz will suppress uncomfortable thoughts and sensations in the target to improve mood. This has the side-effect of dulling sensation and decision-making, which reduces consciousness.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Word of joy

label: Beckon
description:
The carrier automatically learns the beckon psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Psychically command the target to approach the caster.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Beckon

label: Chaos skip
description:
The carrier automatically learns the chaos skip psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Teleport the target to a random position near where it started. Objects above a certain size cannot be teleported.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Chaos skip

label: Vertigo pulse
description:
The carrier automatically learns the vertigo pulse psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Interfere with the spatial orientation sense of everyone near the target point, causing intermittent loss of balance. Flesh creatures will become extremely nauseous as well.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Vertigo pulse

label: Word of love
description:
The carrier automatically learns the word of love psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Speak about someone's romantic virtues while using psychic suggestion to implant romantic desire in the listener. For days afterward, the listener will feel psychically-induced romantic attraction towards the other person. This greatly increases opinion and makes them much more likely to attempt romantic advances and marriage proposals if they get the chance. This power can be used to connect two other people, induce love for the caster, or force oneself to love another.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Word of love

label: Focus
description:
The carrier automatically learns the focus psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Psychically focus the target's mind, boosting their sight, hearing and moving capacities.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Focus

label: Skip
description:
The carrier automatically learns the skip psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Teleport the target to a desired position not too far from its starting point. Objects which are too large cannot be teleported.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Skip

label: Smokepop
description:
The carrier automatically learns the smokepop psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Skip dust particles up from under the ground surface to form a thick cloud. This reduces the accuracy of any shot fired through it, and prevents turrets from locking on entirely.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Smokepop

label: Wallraise
description:
The carrier automatically learns the wallraise psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Form a temporary wall by skipping rubble and soil up from deep under the ground.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Wallraise

label: Word of serenity
description:
The carrier automatically learns the word of serenity psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Use calming words and psychic suggestion to end a mental break on a person. The target will fall into a short psychic sleep. The psyfocus cost depends on the intensity of the target's mental break.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Word of serenity

label: Berserk
description:
The carrier automatically learns the berserk psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Induce an angry psychosis in the target's mind, causing them to attack anyone nearby.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Berserk

label: Farskip
description:
The carrier automatically learns the farskip psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Skip the caster, along with anyone standing near them, to an ally at a distant location. This can send people far across the planet, but only works if there is a willing ally on the other side to use as a navigation beacon. The skipped people will always appear near a random ally on the target map.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Farskip

label: Flashstorm
description:
The carrier automatically learns the flashstorm psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Use differential-pressure skipgates in the atmosphere to generate a localized flashstorm. The storm will strike the area with lightning for some time before dissipating.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Flashstorm

label: Invisibility
description:
The carrier automatically learns the invisibility psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Psychically manipulate the visual centers of everyone nearby, rendering them unable to perceive a particular individual for a short time.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Invisibility

label: Word of inspiration
description:
The carrier automatically learns the word of inspiration psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Speak words encouraging creativity while psychically hypercharging the target's mind with new ideas. The target will experience a random inspiration appropriate to them.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +1

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Word of inspiration

label: Berserk pulse
description:
The carrier automatically learns the berserk pulse psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Generate an overwhelming rush of undirected rage in everyone near the target point.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Berserk pulse

label: Manhunter pulse
description:
The carrier automatically learns the manhunter pulse psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Drive nearby animals into a manhunting rage using a psychic pulse.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Manhunter pulse

label: Mass chaos skip
description:
The carrier automatically learns the mass chaos skip psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Skip everyone in an area to random positions nearby. Objects which are too large cannot be teleported.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Mass chaos skip

label: Neuroquake
description:
The carrier automatically learns the neuroquake psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Find a discontinuity in the psychic field and unfold it, releasing a massive amount of psychic energy. Every creature in range but outside of the safe, inner, circle will be driven violently insane. Casting this takes 12 seconds of meditation, and afterwards, the caster will go into a five-day psychic coma. The disturbing neuroquake echoes will inflict pain on everyone for many kilometers around, causing diplomatic consequences with all factions.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Neuroquake

label: Skipshield
description:
The carrier automatically learns the skipshield psycast, and can use it without a psylink.

Generate a spherical skipgate that sends all incoming and outgoing ground-level projectiles to some distant place. The process is forceful enough to detonate explosive projectiles. People and items are not affected.

Complexity: +3
Archite capsules: +2

Effects:
- Enables psyfocus

Gives ability:
- Skipshield

label: Hemogenic
description:
Carriers of this gene have a reserve of biological strength powered by a resource called hemogen. The resource can be gained and spent in various ways, all of which are unlocked by other genes.

Carriers lose 2 hemogen per day from biological entropy.

Takes effect after age: 3

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +1

Effects:
- Gives hemogen supply.
- Hemogen: -2 per day.

Mood:
- Removes: Ingested hemogen pack: -5

label: Hemogen drain
description:
Carriers lose an additional 8 hemogen per day from biological entropy.

Requires: Hemogenic
Takes effect after age: 3

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +6

Effects:
- Hemogen: -8 per day.

label: Longjump legs
description:
Carriers have special hemogen-powered muscle fibers in their legs which allow them to jump great distances.

Requires: Hemogenic

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Gives ability:
- Longjump

label: Bloodfeeder
description:
Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood. They can bite an unresisting person, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.

Requires: Hemogenic
Takes effect after age: 3

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Gives ability:
- Bloodfeed

Mood:
- Blood torch: +2

label: Coagulate
description:
Carriers of this gene have special glands on their hands and wrists, as well as a unique salivary compound that they can use to rapidly tend wounds.

Requires: Hemogenic
Takes effect after age: 3

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Gives ability:
- Coagulate

label: Piercing spine
description:
Carriers grow an opening in their upper chest along with a quiver of keratin spines. Using a hemogen-powered chemical reaction, they can fire these spines at high speed at nearby targets with surprising accuracy.

Requires: Hemogenic

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Gives ability:
- Piercing spine

label: Deathrest
description:
Carriers of this gene must periodically regenerate themselves in a special coma called deathrest. Deathrest takes days, but can confer substantial bonuses. Deathrest can be accelerated and its effects enhanced by the use of a variety of special buildings and technologies.

Those who put off deathresting will suffer from deathrest exhaustion.

Requires: Hemogenic
Takes effect after age: 3

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +6

Effects:
- Adds need: Deathrest

label: Weak immunity
description:
Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases more slowly than normal. They may die from infections that others would survive.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +2

Effects:
- Immunity gain speed x90%

label: Strong immunity
description:
Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases faster than normal.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Effects:
- Immunity gain speed x110%

label: Super immunity
description:
Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases considerably faster than normal.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Immunity gain speed x150%

label: Slow wound healing
description:
Carriers of this gene heal from wounds half as fast as normal.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +2

Effects:
- Injury healing factor x50%

label: Fast wound healing
description:
Carriers of this gene heal from wounds twice as fast as normal.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Injury healing factor x200%

label: Superfast wound healing
description:
Carriers of this gene heal from wounds four times as fast as normal.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -3

Effects:
- Injury healing factor x400%

label: Superclotting
description:
Carriers of this gene have extra-power coagulating factors in their blood, and will stop bleeding very quickly when wounded.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Effects:
- Bleeding wounds close very quickly.

label: Petrification
description:
Carriers of this gene have a chance to develop a disease named petrification. Petrification slowly replaces tissues throughout the body with stone. The disease is incurable, but progress can be slowed with medical treatment, and the affected tissues can be removed surgically.

Requires: Lithoid

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +4

label: Planet sickness
description:
Carriers of this gene are prone to bouts of nausea and vomiting when on a planet's surface.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +3

label: Psychically deaf
description:
Carriers of this gene are deaf to all psychic energy and influence outside their own minds. They cannot be affected by psychic influence, nor can they ever wield psychic power.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +2

Forced traits:
- Psychically deaf

label: Psychically dull
description:
Carriers of this gene are less psychically-sensitive than others.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +1

Forced traits:
- Psychically dull

label: Psy-sensitive
description:
Carriers of this gene are more psychically-sensitive than average.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Effects:
- Psychic sensitivity +20%
- Meditation psyfocus gain +10% / day
- Neural heat recovery rate +0.10

label: Super psy-sensitive
description:
Carriers of this gene are much more psychically-sensitive than most.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -5

Effects:
- Psychic sensitivity +40%
- Meditation psyfocus gain +20% / day
- Neural heat recovery rate +0.20

label: Psychic bonding
description:
Carriers of this gene have a special neural organ that makes them psychically bond with a lover for life. As long as the lovers are together, they will be happy. If they are physically separated, they will be disturbed by the distance. If one dies, the other's mind will be badly disrupted.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Effects:
- Romance attempts always succeed.
- Gains psychic bond with first romantic partner.

label: Slow runner
description:
Carriers of this gene move more slowly than normal.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +3

Effects:
- Move speed -0.20

label: Fast runner
description:
Carriers of this gene move more quickly than normal.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -3

Effects:
- Move speed +0.20

label: Very fast runner
description:
Carriers of this gene move much more quickly than normal.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -5

Effects:
- Move speed +0.40

label: Naked speed
description:
Carriers of this gene move slower while clothed, and faster while naked.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +2

Effects:
- Move speed -0.20 (clothed)
- Move speed +0.10 (unclothed)

label: Webbed phalanges
description:
Carriers of this gene have webbed fingers and toes, allowing them to move faster in water. Webbed fingers slightly reduce fine motor control.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Effects:
- Manipulation -5%

label: Bat wings
description:
Carriers of this gene have bat-like wings, allowing them to fly for short periods. Wearing some heavy torso-covering items will prevent flight.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -3

Effects:
- Max flight time +8
- Flight cooldown +45
- Manipulation -10%

label: Very unhappy
description:
Carriers of this gene are highly predisposed to negative emotion. They'll see the bad in every situation and have a much lower mood than others.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +5

Mood:
- Genetic depression: -10

label: Unhappy
description:
Carriers of this gene are predisposed to pessimistic perceptions. They'll tend to interpret things negatively and have lower mood than others.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +3

Mood:
- Genetic pessimism: -5

label: Happy
description:
Carriers of this gene are predisposed to optimistic feelings. They'll have higher mood than others.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Mood:
- Genetic optimism: +5

label: Very happy
description:
Carriers of this gene are highly predisposed to optimism and not at all inclined to think negatively. They'll have much higher mood than others.

Complexity: +3
Metabolic efficiency: -2

Mood:
- Genetic joy: +10

label: Stoic
description:
Carriers of this gene are mentally tough and won't break down under stresses that would crack most people.

Complexity: +2
Metabolic efficiency: -1

Forced traits:
- Steadfast

label: Moody
description:
Carriers of this gene have a volatile emotional state. They randomly get good and bad moods.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +1

Mood:
- Bad mood: -12
- Good mood: +12

label: Greedy
description:
Carriers of this gene have an instinctive desire for material possessions. They get a mood penalty if they don't have an impressive bedroom.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +2

Forced traits:
- Greedy

label: Melancholy
description:
Carriers of this gene always have the tortured artist trait, which gives them a permanent mood penalty but also grants a chance to gain creative inspiration after a mental break.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +3

Forced traits:
- Tortured artist

label: Herd instinct
description:
Carriers of this gene need the comfort of being in a large group. They get a mood penalty if there are too few members of the colony. They also don't mind sleeping in a barracks.

Complexity: +1
Metabolic efficiency: +2

Suppressed traits:
- Recluse

Mood:
- Removes: Awful barracks: -7
